description: This file defines the PHP class 'writeexcel_olewriter' which handles writing and managing OLE (Object Linking and Embedding) compound document streams, particularly for creating or manipulating BIFF-based Excel files. It includes methods for initializing, sizing, writing headers, property storage, and closing the stream.

classes.name: writeexcel_olewriter
classes.description: A PHP class that manages the creation and manipulation of OLE compound document streams for BIFF formats used in Excel files.

methods.name: writeexcel_olewriter
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the object with the target filename and sets default properties.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Checks for a valid filename or resource and opens a file handle for writing.

methods.name: set_size
methods.description: Sets the size of data to be written, ensuring it does not exceed maximum limits.

methods.name: _calculate_sizes
methods.description: Computes block sizes and list counts based on the total data size.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Finalizes writing by writing headers, property storage, big block depot, and closes file handles.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the OLE file stream.

methods.name: write_header
methods.description: Writes the OLE header block to the file, including root entry and big block list.

methods.name: _write_big_block_depot
methods.description: Writes the big block depot which manages the list of data blocks.

methods.name: _write_property_storage
methods.description: Writes the property storage properties for the OLE stream, including root and book entries.

methods.name: _write_pps
methods.description: Writes individual property storage item entries.

methods.name: _write_padding
methods.description: Pads the file to align to minimum size requirements.
